_doc: Constitution balance bands — THE tunable envelope every Thể Chất must fit.
Enforced by tests/test_constitution_balance_bands.py: for each process body
the CUMULATIVE L9 kit (flat stat_bonuses + every milestone's stat_bonuses
+ per_level_growth × (max_level−1)) is summed per category below and must
not exceed the rarity's max. To give a new body more room, RAISE the band
here deliberately — the test failing is the signal that a new body would
power-creep past the existing roster.
Caps were derived 2026-07-08 from the 26-body roster: each value is the
current roster maximum (rounded up slightly), so the strongest existing
specialist DEFINES its band. Categories a rarity has never used carry a
small starter allowance instead of 0 so minor use doesn't need a re-tune.
Custom per-body mechanic flags (cp_*, qm_*, vc_*, ...) cannot be banded
generically — those are governed by the design rules below + review.
_resist_note: Any stat key containing 'immune'/'resist'/'negate' authored on a constitution must stay ≤ this — total (1.0) immunity is banned by design (the #24 Tiêu Dao ruling). Stun-class counterplay must always exist.

_doc: Live-combat envelope — catches what stat bands can't: proc/cadence/rider
power from custom mechanics. Enforced by tests/test_constitution_power_bench.py:
every L9 body fights the anchor elite on fixed seeds with a fixed generic
kit and must land inside the thresholds. Calibrated 2026-07-08:
Phàm Thể baseline avg_ttk 14.0 / end_pool 50%; roster spread avg_ttk
3.8 (ThaiBachCanhKim) … 13.6 (ThanhSonBatDong), end_pool 57% … 100%.
avg_ttk_min is the OVER-tune tripwire (nobody may nuke meaningfully
faster than the current top assassin); avg_ttk_max + end_pool_min say a
body must beat the no-constitution baseline on at least that axis.

kit_overrides._doc: Restricted-path bodies measure with a LEGAL kit of the same statistical power — HonDonMaThan bans magical attacks, so it benches on the physical twins of the standard kit (identical dmg/mp/cd).

engine_hard_caps_reference._doc: NOT tunable here — coded clamps, listed so band tuning stays inside them.

constitution_true_dmg_rider.where: casting.py _CONSTITUTION_TRUE_DMG_CAP_PCT — every per-cast rider MUST go through _deal_capped_true_dmg

design_rules_reference: No total immunity: every shrug/negate/resist is a chance ≤ 0.85, and stun-class CC must always have a lane in (VoCauLuuLy keeps CCStun open; HoangCo's Thánh Vực is a 2-turn window, not permanent).
No flat 0-damage gates: 'immune to X-element skills' is banned — use high-but-capped resist or a charge-spend soak that never reaches 0 (ThienThuyThanh precedent).
Revive/cheat-death only when it IS the theme (ChanDuongBatDiet phoenix, TruongXuan spring) — 'not every constitution has revive'.
Per-cast true-damage riders always through casting._deal_capped_true_dmg (12% target-max-HP clamp). Never copy the tail.
Conversion-rate stats (reflect, dmg-per-def/shield/hp, damage_from_heal, cleanse_retaliate...) must NEVER scale with part/level multipliers — NO_SCALE family.
Every runtime stack counter needs an authored cap field, and re-declaring an int cap across milestones DOUBLES it (registry int-merge) — declare caps once.
Before adding an on-hit debuff flag, check the generic _ON_HIT_PROCS lanes in combat/helpers.py (burn/bleed/poison/shock/mark/slow/heal_reduce/blind/te_liet/loi_shred/phong_shred).
New engine immunity/resist gates go in inflict_interceptors.py as one decorated function — never inline guards in inflict_debuff.
